description: Lists your recent AI video jobs: generated clips or AI video edits. Use when the user asks what clips or edits they made, which ones failed, or wants a job ID to check. Not for one job's live progress (use get_video_generation_status). Returns job IDs, status, exercise and date, newest first, with has_more for paging.

kind.description: Which jobs: clip = AI video clips from generate_video_clip; edit = AI video edits from start_video_edit. Defaults to clip.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

status.description: Only jobs in this state: pending = queued; running = in progress; completed = done; failed = did not finish.

name: list_video_jobs
title: List AI video jobs
